name: Catching Fireflies
source:
On a warm summer night, Isabella hears someone outside her window. It's Phineas, who has something special to show her.

A fanmade game of a [url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/3240083]Phinabella fanfic[/url] created by shopgirl152 on AO3.

[From [url=https://dbl-mp.itch.io/catching-fireflies]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个温暖的夏夜，伊莎贝拉听见窗外有人。来的是飞哥，他有特别的东西想给她看。

本作为同人游戏，改编自shopgirl152在AO3创作的一篇[url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/3240083]飞哥与伊莎贝拉同人小说[/url]。

[摘自[url=https://dbl-mp.itch.io/catching-fireflies]itch.io[/url]]
